answers.how: The eagle’s body length is approximately 20.5 pixels and its fully spread wings span about 41–42 pixels. Scaling by the known 0.8 m body length and correcting for depth gives 1.62 m.
Near 1.0 s, the eagle moves approximately 323 pixels per second. Converting with the eagle-length scale and including the depth-direction motion gives 12.8 m/s.
The person moves approximately 29 pixels per second near 1.0 s. Applying the eagle-derived scale and the human-to-eagle camera-distance correction gives 1.16 m/s.
